claim_en: THE IDOLS BAN. Image and pillar paired; the road-heaps; bowing on stone barred in the land, permitted in the sanctuary.
THE CHARTER. The closing verses addressed to the slave of a gentile: the master's ways are no license.
THE SPLIT. Walking is study; remember is the mouth across four seats; learn to do.
THE RAINS. Night schedule with two recorded runs; blessing scoped to the land.
THE SEASONS. Chained without gap; security only in the land.

source: Sifra, Bechukotai, Chapter 1 8 + Chapter 2 1, 3 + Onkelos Lev 26:6
claim_en: PEACE. Weighed against all; the beast ceases (R. Shimon, Onkelos); no armies in transit (Onkelos).
THE SCALING. Five-to-a-hundred versus a-hundred-to-a-myriad: superlinear by the ink's own arithmetic.
TURNING. The long laborer's reckoning; the covenant not the broken first one; Onkelos writes 'to do you good'.
OLD OF OLD. Aging as improvement; the clearing anxiety.
THE DWELLING. The Temple; no second rejection; Onkelos's Presence for the walking.
SLAVES TO KINGS. Not slaves' slaves; the upright measure disputed; Onkelos's freedom.
THE CONDITION. Contempt for the oral layer; the knowing rebel by the preposition.
THE DESCENT. Seven states in clause order, each entailing the next.
THE CREDITOR. Anger; the Name as creditor; four worsening states; the two-year sowing.
THE MIRROR. One verb in good and in evil; rulers from among you; Onkelos's anger for the face.
SEVENFOLD. Warning precedes; seven for seven; the pride of strength's three referents.
THE METALS. Iron sky against brass sky ordered by sweat; Onkelos writes the withheld rain and fruit into the verse.
KERI. Casual for casual; the beasts that bite and kill; Onkelos's one word with rigor.
THE SWORD. Two vengeances; the overnight-corpse law as mechanism; the staff of bread; Onkelos expands the vengeance.

source: Sifra, Bechukotai, Chapter 6 4-7 + Chapter 7 1 + Onkelos Lev 26:30-31
claim_en: SANCTUARIES. Synagogues by the doubled token; good and harsh measures paired; Onkelos's congregation's offering.

source: Sifra, Bechukotai, Chapter 7 2 + Chapter 8 9 + Onkelos Lev 26:34-35
claim_en: THE SABBATH-DEBT. Missed releases accrue as the land's debt, collected in exile; Onkelos names them releases.
FAINTNESS. The word defined; the leaf memory recorded as the verse's fulfillment.
SURETY. Stumbling in a brother's sin; mutual liability from the preposition.
PERISHING. Exile by the doublet; R. Akiva's ten tribes.
THE FATHERS' SINS. Judged by them only when held; Onkelos writes 'which they hold' into the verse.
CONFESSION. Mercy at confession and at humbling; the good measure of the enemies' land; Onkelos's foolish heart.
THE FATHERS. Fallback chain by the reversed order; token presence reasoned; matriarchs by the particle; the land in the covenant.
THE FOUR ERAS. One in a hundred; four clauses to four eras; the tribes' covenant; Onkelos's curses for blessings.
TWO TORAHS. Written and oral from the plural token; laws, details, explanations from Sinai; Onkelos keeps the plural.
